title: When News Gets Old: Portfolio Allocation with Reinforcement Learning and Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.30564v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Financial news can influence investment decisions long after publication. Timely news may reach an investor before prices fully adjust, whereas older news may already be reflected in prices. We examine two ways to handle aging signals: retain them and give a portfolio policy timing information, or filter them out before portfolio selection. A fixed large language model (LLM) extracts signals from public SEC disclosures. We compare these treatments in reinforcement learning (RL) policies and LLMs that choose portfolios directly. We evaluate returns after trading costs in historical tests over 2023-2025. RL choices respond to timing information in a controlled test, but historical returns show no consistent benefit from adding it. For the LLM, filtering old news produced the highest average net return, reaching 18.43% per year when news delivery was delayed by four weeks. This exceeded the returns of all RL strategies that used news.

translated_title: 当新闻变旧时：基于强化学习与大语言模型的投资组合配置
translated_abstract: 金融新闻在发布后的很长时间内仍可能影响投资决策。及时的新闻可能在价格充分调整之前到达投资者手中，而较旧的新闻可能已经反映在价格中。我们研究了两种处理老化信号的方法：保留它们并向投资组合策略提供时间信息，或在投资组合选择之前将其过滤掉。一个固定的大语言模型（LLM）从公开的SEC文件中提取信号。我们在强化学习（RL）策略和直接选择投资组合的LLM中比较这些处理方法。我们在2023-2025年的历史测试中评估扣除交易成本后的收益。在受控测试中，RL选择会对时间信息作出反应，但历史收益显示添加时间信息并无一致的好处。对于LLM而言，过滤旧新闻产生了最高的平均净收益，当新闻交付延迟四周时，年化收益达到18.43%。这超过了所有使用新闻的RL策略的收益。
tldr: 研究发现在LLM驱动的投资组合配置中，过滤旧新闻比向策略提供时间信息更有效——当年新闻延迟四周交付时，过滤旧新闻可实现18.43%的年化净收益，并优于所有基于新闻的强化学习策略。
en_tdlr: In LLM-based portfolio allocation, filtering out old news outperforms providing timing information to the policy, achieving 18.43% annual net returns when news delivery was delayed by four weeks, exceeding all news-based reinforcement learning strategies.
